info.name: Text Anonymizer
info.description:
Detect and redact personal and sensitive information (PII) in text and text files, for example before using the text in an AI prompt.
Powered by [Presidio](https://presidio.dataprivacystack.org/).
### Features
- **Detect sensitive text**: a TaskProcessing task that lists each distinct PII entity found in a text. - **Redact sensitive text**: a TaskProcessing task that replaces each PII entity with a placeholder naming its type, e.g. `Call John at 555-123-4567` becomes `Call <PERSON> at <PHONE_NUMBER>`. - **Redact text files**: a "Redact text" action in Files that saves a redacted copy next to the original text file, which is left unchanged. - Detects names, email addresses, phone numbers, locations, dates, credit card numbers, IBANs, IP addresses, URLs and more. - Handles long texts and reports task progress.
### Limitations
- English only. - Detection is not perfect: some sensitive text may be missed and some harmless text may be redacted. Check the output before relying on it. - Redaction cannot be undone, and the detection task's output contains the sensitive values it found. - The Files action only supports UTF-8 encoded plain text files, not documents such as ODT, DOCX or PDF. - Tasks are processed one at a time on the CPU. - No settings yet.
info.author: Edward Ly
